Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.src: I know who you are, {u}. Do you know who I am?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.dst: Я знаю, кто ты, {u}. А ты знаешь, кто я?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#002.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.src: Enough playing around, I need your assistance. You see... There is something fishy going on behind these doors.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.dst: Шутки в сторону, мне нужна твоя помощь. Понимаешь… за этими воротами дело нечисто.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#004.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.src: Have you ever heard the saying "Elves never die", well it's true, or so at least I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.dst: Слышал поговорку «Эльфы не умирают»? Это правда - по крайней мере, я так думал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#005.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.src: You see, my family and a few other elves left {p} Town a long time ago to start a new life in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.dst: Понимаешь, моя семья и ещё несколько эльфов давно ушли из города {p}, чтобы начать новую жизнь в {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#008.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.src: I've always heard since I was young that Elves cannot die from old age. Well... recently, my parents both died.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.dst: С детства я слышал, что эльфы не умирают от старости. А недавно… умерли оба моих родителя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#009.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.src: More and more people around {p} have died! But none in {p}. I think something sketchy is going on in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.dst: Вокруг {p} умирает всё больше народу! А в {p} - никто. Думаю, тут творится что-то тёмное.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#010.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.src: Please, {u}. I really need your help. Us {p} elves aren't exactly welcomed with open arms in {p}. It's a surprise they even let us in at all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.dst: Прошу, {u}. Мне правда нужна помощь. Нас, эльфов из {p}, в {p} не жалуют. Удивительно, что нас вообще впустили.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#011.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.src: Could you try asking around, see if anyone knows about this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.dst: Можешь поспрашивать, вдруг кто-то что-то знает?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#012.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.src: I will wait up here. Return to me if you find out any valuable information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.dst: Я подожду здесь, наверху. Узнаешь что-то ценное - возвращайся.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#013.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#014.src: Check with the elves around {p} Town for information.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.src: Welcome to {p} Town. Home of the elves.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.dst: Добро пожаловать в город {p}, дом эльфов.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#015.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.dst: Я слышала о вас и о том, что было в долине.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#017.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#020.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.src: I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#022.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.src: But why are you telling me that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.dst: Но зачем вы мне это говорите?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#026.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.src: Your attitude is really starting to annoy me, young traveler.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.dst: Ваше поведение начинает меня раздражать, юный путник.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#028.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.src: I don't care if you have defeated all the monsters in the world, never ask a woman like me of her age.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.dst: Хоть вы всех чудовищ на свете победите - никогда не спрашивайте даму вроде меня о возрасте.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#029.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.src: You seem like such a kind adventurer, you humans aren't all so bad.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.dst: Вы, кажется, добрый искатель приключений. Не все люди так уж плохи.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#031.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.src: How come you are so curious?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#033.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.src: Well... when I think about it. No.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#034.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.src: Actually. There is an old tale for children about a dying elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.dst: Хотя. Есть старая детская сказка об умирающем эльфе.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#035.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.src: I never thought much about it since I have never seen anyone in here die before.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.dst: Я никогда о ней не задумывалась - ведь я ни разу не видела, чтобы здесь кто-то умер.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#036.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.src: I heard that there is some old graveyard somewhere in {p}. Probably just some weird story.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.dst: Говорят, где-то в {p} есть старое кладбище. Наверное, просто байка.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#037.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.src: I'm so sorry to hear that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#038.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.src: I don't really see how that is connected to {p} though.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.dst: Правда, не вижу, при чём тут {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#039.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.src: You never ask a woman her age. Did you not know that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.dst: Даму о возрасте не спрашивают. Вы не знали?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#042.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.dst: Скажу лишь, что я достаточно стара.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#043.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.dst: Не бойся, великая Amber поможет тебе найти дорогу!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#047.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.dst: Меня зовут Amber, я из королевского спецотряда посольства Sol!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#049.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.dst: Мой долг - защищать город от злодеев!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#050.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.dst: Ты ведь НЕ ВОР? НЕ ГРАБИТЕЛЬ? НЕ УБИЙЦА!? НЕ ПОДЖИГАТЕЛЬ!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#051.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#053.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.dst: Моя главная работа - патрулировать округу и следить, чтобы никто не делал ничего запретного.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#054.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.src: I also report anything I hear people talk about that they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.dst: А ещё я докладываю обо всём, что люди говорят, а не должны.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#055.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#057.src: Can I help you with anything else?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what. Who buys what. Who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.dst: Кто входит в город и уходит. Кто что продаёт. Кто что покупает. Кто с кем говорит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#059.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#060.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.dst: Ты смеешь так со мной говорить?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#084.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.dst: Я добьюсь твоей высылки, даже если это будет последнее, что я сделаю!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#085.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.src: That's me! Sol the Smart, Sol the Clever, Sol the Best. I go by many names.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.dst: Это я! Sol Умный, Sol Мудрый, Sol Лучший. У меня много имён.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#086.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#087.src: So what is it you need?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.src: Hmm. I'm sorry but I can't talk about that too much.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.dst: Хмм. Прости, но об этом я много говорить не могу.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#089.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#090.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#091.src: I will tell you this, Elves used to die from old age around {~} years ago.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#099.dst: Прощай. И скажи всем, что я самый умный!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#099.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#100.src: Pfft. No way am I telling you any secret information about {p}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#101.src: Elves may die, elves may not. I don't know.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#104.src: I was just taking a... little nap. No need to be so loud.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#105.src: So why did you wake me up?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#108.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#109.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......

Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.src: It's the capital of the elves. It's a dream for all elves to live in here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.dst: Это столица эльфов. Все эльфы мечтают здесь жить.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#110.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#112.src: {p} might look really pretty on the outside, but really, they are all hiding something in here.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#112.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.dst: Видишь ли, я моложе многих здесь. Мне всего около ста лет.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#113.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#118.src: I'm the only new elf this century. At least here.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#119.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.dst: Я глянул на полки за ними и увидел бумаги, подписанные другим именем.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.dst: Так вопрос в том… что с ним стало?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.src: No- but I noticed something that didn't add up with our previous information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.dst: Нет, но я заметил то, что не сходится с прежними сведениями.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.src: One of the seats were empty and one of the elves mentioned six elders, did she not?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.dst: Одно место пустовало, а одна эльфийка упоминала шесть старейшин, так ведь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.dst: Я глянул на полки за ними и увидел бумаги, подписанные другим именем.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.dst: Так вопрос в том… что с ним стало?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.src: I'm guessing the Elders got into a big disagreement and decided to rid of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.dst: Думаю, старейшины крупно разругались и решили от него избавиться.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.src: So I doubt they have any records of that occuring here...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.dst: Так что вряд ли здесь есть записи об этом…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.src: Our best bet is to find somebody that may have seen what happened here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.dst: Лучше всего найти того, кто мог видеть, что тут произошло.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.src: Y'know I'm pretty good friends with the {p} Scouts.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.src: They are really observant of everything that goes on in and around the canyons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.dst: Они внимательно следят за всем, что творится в каньонах и вокруг.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.src: Meet me outside the {p} {p}, speak with me if you'd like to travel there together.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.dst: Встретимся у {p} {p}. Поговори со мной, если хочешь отправиться туда вместе.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.src: Meet up with Olon outside the {p} in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.dst: Встреться с Olon у {p} в {p}, в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.src: Let's go then! Glad you want to travel with me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.dst: Тогда в путь! Рад, что ты идёшь со мной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.src: Here we are! The capital of Gavel, home of a lot of things I'm sure.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.dst: Вот и пришли! Столица Gavel, где, наверное, есть всё на свете.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.src: Alright- so we have to come up with a plan on what to do next, I have a few suggestions myself.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.dst: Так, нам нужно придумать план дальнейших действий. У меня есть пара идей.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.src: I've done some work for the {p} staff in the past and happen to know a few of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.dst: Я когда-то работал на служащих {p} и кое-кого из них знаю.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.src: We are actually quite good friends, what do you think?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.dst: Мы вообще-то неплохие друзья. Что скажешь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.src: Sounds like a good plan to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.src: Head inside and look for someone who doesn't seem busy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.dst: Зайди внутрь и найди кого-нибудь, кто не занят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#345.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#346.src: So you want us to sneak in?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#346.dst: Так ты хочешь, чтобы мы прокрались?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#346.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.src: Do you even know where we need to go?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.dst: Ты хоть знаешь, куда нам идти?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.src: Thought so... good thing I'm here then!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.dst: Так и думал… хорошо, что я здесь!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.dst: Как я уже говорил, я помогал ухаживать за садами внутри.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.dst: Разумеется, я кое-что там разузнал! И вот мой вывод…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.dst: На верху зала гильдии есть комната со старыми военными документами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: Ею почти не пользуются, так что подняться будет непросто… встретимся под мостом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: Сто лет тебя не видел! У меня всё хорошо, у семьи тоже!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.dst: Рад слышать! Слушай, мы сегодня заняты - не знаешь, где хранят старые военные документы?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.dst: Это про твою теорию? Кстати, я недавно там работал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.dst: Рядом со мной, вверх по лестнице, есть лифт.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#359.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.dst: Заходи потом поболтать! Скучаю по нашим беседам.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#360.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.dst: Отлично! Поднимемся на этом лифте прямо сейчас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#362.dst: Встреться с Olon под мостом в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.dst: Архив должен быть на вершине одной из больших башен {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#363.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.dst: Мне пришла блестящая идея - наделить тебя частью моей магии, чтобы пробраться внутрь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#364.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: Хочу повидаться со старым другом. Надеюсь, скоро увидимся.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.dst: Воспользуйся лужей магии в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы отправиться к архиву.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.dst: Вернись в город {p}: через торговца-жонглёра в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] или пешком до [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.dst: Есть находка? Здорово, всё как я и думал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#375.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.dst: Так, план такой. Я останусь и поищу карту упомянутого места - они почти всегда отмечают отчёты как надо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#376.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.dst: Встретимся в городе {p}, у восточного выхода. Пока лучше избегать старейшин.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.dst: Если хочешь вернуться в город {p}, говорят, в {p} есть так называемый торговец-«жонглёр», который отвезёт тебя бесплатно.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.dst: Эта дорога ведёт в {p}, так что искать, возможно, придётся долго.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.dst: Каньон движется сам по себе. Ладно, в путь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: Я не собираюсь вас останавливать. Наоборот, я хочу помочь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.dst: В этом городе, в этом обществе многое неправильно. Решения, что мы принимали…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#387.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.dst: Мы, эльфы, не идеальны. Хоть и любим твердить обратное - и многие искренне в это верят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: Я всегда хотел изменить {p}, но убеждать тех, кто закоснел в своих кривых путях, тяжело.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.dst: Прошу, верните Старейшину Birch - ради меня. Идите по горной дороге направо, пока не увидите пещеру с грибами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.dst: А я пока кое-что спрошу у старейшин. Удачи вам обоим.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#391.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: Venture into the {p} and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: Пройди в {p} и найди вход к запечатанному старейшине в [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: Find your way through the canyon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.dst: У вас минута, чтобы объяснить, кто вы и что здесь делаете, пока горы вокруг вас не рухнули.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#395.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.dst: Эльф и человек - в моём доме!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.dst: Передайте ИМ: с изгнания я сижу дома. Я молчу и даже не помышляю ни о чём таком.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#398.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.dst: Мы не со старейшинами. Я из {p}! Мы здесь ради правды.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.dst: Они… хотят… вернуть меня? Вы за этим пришли?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.dst: Мы никак не связаны со старейшинами! У меня личные причины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.dst: Докажите! Не верю, что они так быстро обо мне забыли.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.dst: И что? Это ничего не доказывает.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#412.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.dst: Что… что он сказал обо мне?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.dst: Конечно, он всегда был на моей стороне.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#417.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.dst: Знаете что - я пойду с вами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: Но ничего не скажу. Я иду только ради Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.dst: Alder никогда бы так не сказал… тем более таким, как вы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.dst: Хотя… я очень по нему скучаю…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#421.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.dst: Не выйдет - не вижу, как это докажет, что вы не от старейшин.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#423.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: Если вас прислали старейшины, ответ вы и так знаете.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#428.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.src: Are you two a bit slow or what? We are not killing anyone!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.dst: Вы что, туго соображаете? Мы никого не убиваем!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.src: If anything, the {p} elves brought it upon themselves by leaving our city.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.dst: Уж скорее эльфы {p} сами навлекли это на себя, уйдя из нашего города.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.src: Let's just say the town is magical. That's all you need to know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.dst: Скажем так: город волшебный. Больше вам знать не нужно.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#432.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.src: Really... it seems I can't escape the past.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.dst: Надо же… похоже, от прошлого не убежать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.src: I don't know what it is... but I want you to tell me more...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.dst: Не знаю, в чём дело… но я хочу услышать больше…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.src: Maybe it's time- time to confront the elders again. We must go.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.dst: Может, пора - пора снова встретиться со старейшинами. Нам нужно идти.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.src: Of course things happened- things happen everywhere!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.dst: Конечно, всякое бывало - всякое бывает везде!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#439.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.src: Elves are magical, that's why the city is magical.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.dst: Эльфы волшебны, потому и город волшебный.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#440.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.src: I'm not going to tell you anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#441.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.src: {p} doesn't care about {p} elves, why would they kill them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.dst: {p} нет дела до эльфов {p}, зачем их убивать?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.src: Well, why are you here then?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#444.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.src: If you are so close, what do you need me for?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.dst: Раз вы так близки к разгадке, зачем вам я?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.src: Even though I have been banished, I would never want something like that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.dst: Пусть меня изгнали, но такого я не желаю никому.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.src: Go on ahead. This is not something I expected to happen...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.dst: Идите. Кто бы мог подумать, что так выйдет…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.src: Return to the Elders with Elder Birch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.dst: Вернись к старейшинам вместе со Старейшиной Birch в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.src: You've got guts coming back here after everyth-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.dst: Хватило же наглости вернуться после все…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.src: Actually- we have someone that you might be interested in meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.dst: Вообще-то у нас тут кое-кто, с кем вы, может, захотите встретиться.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.src: What is the meaning of this?!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.src: It's been so long, I didn't think you would come back.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.dst: Столько времени прошло. Я не думал, что ты вернёшься.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#457.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.src: Alder- I am sorry but the only reason I have returned is to set things right once and for all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.dst: Alder, прости, но вернуться меня заставило одно: раз и навсегда всё исправить.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.src: These two individuals have the right to know what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.dst: Эти двое имеют право знать, что происходит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.src: Are you out of your MIND! We voted on this all those years ago!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.dst: Ты В СВОЁМ УМЕ?! Мы голосовали за это много лет назад!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.src: If you tell them ANYTHING about the tree I will make sure your eternal life ends right here and now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.dst: Скажешь им ХОТЬ СЛОВО о дереве - и твоя вечная жизнь оборвётся здесь и сейчас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.src: Oak- that is ENOUGH! Can't you see- this human is fighting the war we begun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.dst: Oak, ХВАТИТ! Не видишь? Этот человек ведёт войну, начатую нами!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.src: They've earned it- they should know. Salvation of our light, our redemption!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.dst: Они это заслужили - пусть знают. Спасение нашего Света, наше искупление!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#464.src: I agree with Elder Birch, sir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#464.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.src: {u}, Olon- the war you are fighting...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.src: We- we are the ones to blame. Our kind, our people...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.dst: Это мы… виноваты мы. Наш род, наш народ…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.src: The elves are the reason the world is in calamity. All because of one, senseless, selfish mistake.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.dst: Эльфы - причина бедствий мира. И всё из-за одной бессмысленной, эгоистичной ошибки.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.src: The worst fate that this world has seen, a fate beyond comprehension.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.dst: Худшая участь, что видел этот мир, участь за гранью понимания.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.src: Your leading question, about our immortality. The answer is simple- but there is more to it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.dst: Ваш главный вопрос - о нашем бессмертии. Ответ прост, но за ним кроется большее.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.src: We... we revealed the first gate- giving way for the darkness...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.dst: Мы… мы открыли первые врата - дав дорогу тьме…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.src: I'd rather if we show you. Meet me under the Cherry Blossom tree.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.dst: Лучше мы покажем. Встретимся под цветущей вишней.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.src: I- I will join you as well.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.dst: Я… я тоже пойду с вами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#475.src: Head down to the Cherry Blossom tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.src: This place- here is where it all began.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.dst: Это место… здесь всё и началось.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#476.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.src: The center of the Elven society, under the tree that protects our civilization.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.dst: Сердце эльфийского общества, под деревом, что хранит нашу цивилизацию.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#477.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#478.src: And, brings upon us our immortality...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#478.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.src: The roots expand deep inside this cavern that we've used for storage over the years.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.dst: Корни уходят глубоко в эту пещеру, которую мы годами использовали как хранилище.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.src: At least two Elders are required to open the passage. We will open the way for you two now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.dst: Чтобы открыть проход, нужны минимум двое старейшин. Сейчас мы откроем путь вам двоим.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.src: Be careful, nobody was meant to return there so certain defense mechanisms were put in place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.dst: Осторожнее: никто не должен был туда возвращаться, поэтому там установлены защитные механизмы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.src: Also, the information you will learn can harm all elves, unfortunately some things must be kept a secret.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.dst: И ещё: то, что вы узнаете, может навредить всем эльфам. Увы, некоторые вещи должны оставаться тайной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.src: I've had a very bad feeling that we won't like what we see...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.dst: У меня дурное предчувствие, что увиденное нам не понравится…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.src: Well... It's too late to back down now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.src: Do you feel the magical energy, it's almost like I can touch it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.dst: Чувствуешь магическую энергию? Её будто можно потрогать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.src: Is the water filled with logs?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.src: Have you noticed this... plant in the middle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.src: It seems like this place is so alive, I mean just look at all of this coming from the logs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.dst: Здесь всё будто полно жизни - ты только глянь, сколько всего растёт из брёвен!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.src: If you are here to stop us, we won't hesitate to hurt you!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.dst: Если вы пришли нас остановить, мы не колеблясь дадим отпор!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.src: On the contrary. I... realize, that this is something we can no longer keep quiet about.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.dst: Напротив. Я… понял, что об этом больше нельзя молчать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#495.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.src: When you brought back Birch... it brought back memories, and I must admit. It made me realize I had lost myself along the way.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.dst: Когда вы вернули Birch… вернулись и воспоминания, и должен признать: я понял, что по пути потерял себя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.src: We were ashamed of our actions- all of us. Scared for our people. If they knew the truth... there would be riots, wars, innocents would die!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.dst: Мы стыдились своих поступков - все мы. Боялись за свой народ. Узнай он правду… начались бы бунты, войны, гибли бы невинные!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#498.src: But because we locked up {p} from the outside, we grew a... god complex, so to speak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#498.dst: Но, закрыв {p} от внешнего мира, мы, так сказать… возомнили себя богами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#498.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.src: We lost track of why we locked ourselves in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.src: You will find the answers to your questions once you lay grasp of the wood.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.dst: Вы найдёте ответы на свои вопросы, как только коснётесь древесины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.src: I assume you two already noticed the intense magical energy coming from here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.dst: Полагаю, вы оба уже заметили мощную магическую энергию отсюда.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.src: This is the source of our immortality.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#503.src: The remnants of the original Guardian of the Forest.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#503.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.dst: Войди в бревно вместе с Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#506.src: I have summoned you two for an important meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#506.dst: Я созвал вас двоих на важное собрание.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#506.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#508.src: What did you see this time?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#508.dst: Что ты увидел на этот раз?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#508.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.src: It was unclear... The only thing I'm certain of is that he contacted me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.dst: Всё смутно… Точно знаю одно: Он связался со мной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.src: I think... I think he wants us to witness him. This is finally our chance to grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.dst: Думаю… думаю, Он хочет, чтобы мы узрели Его. Наконец-то наш шанс постичь Свет.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.src: And I know how we do that!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.dst: И я знаю, как это сделать!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.src: You must have realized by now that he is a direct contact to the other side. I think... I think it's time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.dst: Вы уже должны были понять, что он - прямая связь с той стороной. Думаю… думаю, время пришло.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.src: ...cutting down the Guardian of the Forest!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#517.src: Believe me- I hear how ludicrous this all sounds.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#517.dst: Поверьте, я понимаю, как нелепо это звучит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#517.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.src: But think, why would I have visions of witnessing him moments after visions of the Guardian?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.dst: Но подумайте: почему сразу после видений о Хранителе мне явились видения, где мы узрим Его?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#518.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#519.src: We would be the first of our kind to witness him before death!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#519.dst: Мы станем первыми из нашего народа, кто узрит Его при жизни!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#519.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.src: I believe that's what he wants!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.dst: Я верю, что этого Он и хочет!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#522.src: Today is the day we meet our God!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#522.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.src: We will take down the Guardian of the Forest to open a gateway!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.dst: Мы повалим Хранителя леса, чтобы открыть врата!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.src: Today we establish history and a new chapter for all elves!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.dst: Сегодня мы творим историю и новую главу для всех эльфов!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.src: We do not have the time. Move along, young one.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.dst: У нас нет времени. Ступай, дитя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#527.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.src: Wait! I don't think... this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.dst: Постойте! Мне кажется… это плохая идея.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#528.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#530.src: But... I really don't think you should go ahead and hurt the Gua-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#530.dst: Но… правда, не стоит вредить Хра…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#530.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#531.src: As the Elders of this town we've already decided on this. You are welcome to join us for this moment, young elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#531.dst: Мы, старейшины города, уже всё решили. Можешь разделить с нами этот миг, юная эльфийка.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#531.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.src: But if you as much as try to stop us, you will be banished.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.dst: Но если хоть попытаешься помешать, тебя изгонят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.src: Talk to the Elders about the vision.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.src: This secret can never leave {p}. If it does- people will riot and wars will break out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.dst: Эта тайна никогда не должна покинуть {p}. Иначе будут бунты и начнутся войны.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.src: Elves who had nothing to do with their decision will die.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.dst: Погибнут эльфы, не причастные к тому решению.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.src: This is far greater than any of us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.dst: Это куда важнее любого из нас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.src: I understand you may have questions.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.dst: Понимаю, у вас могут быть вопросы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.src: Elder Prometheus died of old age, almost everyone from that time is dead. He elected us six to keep the secret safe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.dst: Старейшина Prometheus умер от старости, как почти все из той эпохи. Он избрал нас шестерых хранить тайну.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.src: Apparently the immortality hadn't set in just yet- magic takes time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.dst: Видимо, бессмертие тогда ещё не вступило в силу - магии нужно время.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.src: I don't think he really understood the extent of what he had done. We slowly began connecting the dots.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.dst: Не думаю, что он осознал масштаб содеянного. Мы понемногу начали связывать всё воедино.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.src: Everything seemed to lead back to the portals opening- the war in Wynn and the attack on Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.dst: Всё указывало на открытие порталов - войну в Wynn и нападение на Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#549.src: The magical wood from the Guardian of the Forest must radiate magic that grants us our life.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#549.dst: Волшебная древесина Хранителя леса, должно быть, излучает магию, дарующую нам жизнь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#549.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.src: This is why we locked up {p}, letting people live immortal lives would have dire consequences.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.dst: Вот почему мы закрыли {p}: бессмертие для всех имело бы ужасные последствия.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.src: We tried to at least make up for some of the damage we had done...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.dst: Мы пытались хоть отчасти искупить причинённый вред…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#551.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.src: The portal being opened here caused a chain reaction that opened every portal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.dst: Открытый здесь портал вызвал цепную реакцию, открывшую все порталы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.src: This is unfortunately what cursed the world and made it possible for the corruption to leak into Wynn and beings of darkness to breach Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.dst: Увы, именно это прокляло мир, позволив Скверне просочиться в Wynn, а созданиям тьмы - прорваться в Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#553.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.src: This used to be an open cave that we decided to hide the rest of the Guardian in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.dst: Раньше это была открытая пещера, в которой мы решили спрятать остатки Хранителя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#554.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.src: It seems like the immense magic transformed this place to look like this...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.dst: Похоже, огромная магия превратила это место в то, что вы видите…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.src: We can't put innocent lives at risk- don't you agree?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.dst: Мы не можем подвергать опасности невинных - согласны?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.src: We will make our leave, you can jump after us to return to {p} Town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.dst: Мы уходим. Прыгайте следом, чтобы вернуться в город {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.src: I didn't even hear you come in. I was too sucked up in this interesting book "Live Life Love Life".
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.dst: Я и не заметил твоего прихода. Слишком увлёкся занятной книгой «Live Life Love Life».
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.src: I've been reading all day to get myself in a different head space.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.dst: Я весь день читаю, чтобы настроиться на другой лад.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.src: Ah, who am I kidding- this book SUCKS!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.src: Come back tomorrow, please. I have about five more books to get through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.dst: Приходи завтра, пожалуйста. Мне ещё книг пять осилить.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.src: I got inspired from my journey through the world of motivational writing yesterday.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.dst: Вчерашнее путешествие в мир мотивационной литературы меня вдохновило.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.src: The best thing in the world is to help people around you, is that not right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.dst: Лучшее на свете - помогать окружающим, разве нет?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.src: This way I'll keep myself busy while still being of assistance.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.dst: Так я займу себя и заодно буду полезен.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#570.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.src: Well, I'm doing better. Thank you for asking.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.dst: Ну, мне уже лучше. Спасибо за заботу.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.src: My shame is slowly turning into hatred for those old elders, maybe that's progress.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.dst: Мой стыд понемногу превращается в ненависть к тем старым старейшинам - может, это прогресс.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.src: Please come back tomorrow, I have a gift for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.dst: Приходи завтра, пожалуйста, у меня для тебя подарок.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.src: I know I couldn't have done anything, I just find it so stupid.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.dst: Знаю, что ничего не мог поделать, просто это так глупо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#575.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.src: Stupid that the so called, "all mighty, selfless elves" did something like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.dst: Глупо, что «всемогущие, бескорыстные эльфы» сотворили такое.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.src: Please come back tomorrow, I have a gift for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.dst: Приходи завтра, пожалуйста, у меня для тебя подарок.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.src: You are earlier than I expected.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.src: I was planning to cook you a nice meal to as a thank you for getting me through these past two days and for helping me earlier.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.dst: Я хотел приготовить тебе вкусный ужин в благодарность за поддержку в эти два дня и за помощь раньше.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.src: I decided to pick up a couple of new hobbies to get my mind working, cooking being one of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.dst: Я решил завести пару новых хобби, чтобы занять голову, - готовка одно из них.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#582.src: You have truly done more than I ever could have imagined. I'm proud to call you my friend.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#582.dst: Твои дела превзошли всё, что я мог вообразить. Горжусь, что могу звать тебя другом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#582.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.src: I may or may not have forgot a couple of ingredients for my stew!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.dst: Я, может быть, забыл пару ингредиентов для рагу!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.src: Can you go around the forest seeing if you can find [{~} Leafy Stalks] and [{~} Mycanoid Spores] please.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.dst: Можешь пройтись по лесу и найти [{~} листовых стеблей] и [{~} спор Mycanoid]?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.src: I think I'm finally getting over my guilt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.dst: Кажется, я наконец справляюсь с чувством вины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.src: I realized that I never really took time to grieve my parents' death and I guess I was so occupied finding an answer to my big conspiracy that {p} killed them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.dst: Я понял, что так и не оплакал родителей - видимо, был слишком занят доказательством своей большой теории заговора, что их убил {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.src: Then finding out all that information... It just all came crashing down on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.dst: А потом, когда всё выяснилось… всё просто рухнуло на меня.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#589.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.src: I'm grateful that you've managed to pull me out of that dark space, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.dst: Спасибо тебе: без тебя я бы из этой тьмы не выбрался, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.src: I stayed up all night working on this new project of mine.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.dst: Я всю ночь не спал, работая над новым проектом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.src: I picked up the wonderful art of painting and decided to make something for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.dst: Я освоил чудесное искусство живописи и решил кое-что для тебя сделать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#595.src: I've also gone the entire day feeling good, for once.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#595.dst: И впервые за долгое время весь день мне было хорошо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#595.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.src: I feel like I'm back on track. So it's time for me to start stressing over another conspiracy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.dst: Кажется, я вернулся в колею. Значит, пора начинать переживать из-за нового заговора.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#596.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#597.src: I'm actually on my way to the {p} library to do some light reading, hoping to stumble upon another mystery.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#597.dst: Я как раз иду в библиотеку {p} почитать что-нибудь лёгкое, в надежде наткнуться на новую тайну.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#597.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.src: I hope you are careful on wherever journey leads you. If you ever need me, just drop by.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.dst: Береги себя, куда бы ни завёл тебя путь. Если понадоблюсь - заходи.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.speaker: Olon
